tool_args.rationale: A finer trajectory batch is targeted at distinguishing the smooth basin and external-leak branch with enough independent observations to fit their parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic basin with an external-leak branch now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The six rows contain only one clearly open-branch observation, while the near-duplicate pilot rows add little independent information. The branch shape and basin parameters are not yet identifiable.
The existing open-branch observation establishes a departure from the simple basin, but one further point would still leave limited information about its shape.
All observations are at the target horizon, so resolving the branch and gradient dependence is more immediately useful than extrapolating in horizon.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
